info.title: Wizer Signage API
info.description: Wizer Signage — multi-tenant digital signage SaaS platform REST API.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier, unique across the platform.

companyId.description: null for a platform-level Super Admin.

accessToken.description: Short-lived bearer token for the Authorization header.

refreshToken.description: Rotated on every use; reuse is treated as theft.

mustEnableTwoFactor.description: True when the account must enrol in 2FA before it has full access — a Super Admin, or a user whose company enforces it. The session is confined to the enrollment routes until it does.

challengeToken.description: Present the code for this challenge at POST /auth/login/2fa.

email.description: Taken from the invitation, never from the request body.

permissions.description: Effective permissions, derived from the DATABASE role rather than the token.

twoFactorRequired.description: Whether 2FA is mandatory for this account.

accessToken.description: Short-lived bearer token scoped to the impersonated company.

reason.description: The justification the admin gave when starting it (`impersonationNote`).

ip.description: Where the impersonation was started from.

byStatus.description: Every status in the enum, INCLUDING the ones at zero — `toStatusMap` seeds the map from the full enum before folding the groupBy in, so a missing key means a new status the API does not know about rather than a count of none.

unpaidTotal.description: Summed with Number(), so it is a JSON number rather than the string a Decimal column would otherwise serialise to.

active.description: Still TRIALING and not past its end date.

expired.description: EXPIRED, or TRIALING but past its end date — the second case is a subscription the expiry job has not swept yet, and it counts as expired here rather than as active.

companyId.description: null for a platform-level Super Admin.

token.description: Single-use acceptance token, returned ONLY here. The database stores a hash, so it cannot be read back later. Treat it as a credential: do not log it, and deliver it over a channel you would send a password reset link over.

companyId.description: Owning tenant. Derived from the caller's token, never the body.

timezone.description: IANA zone. Schedules resolve against it, so a bare city name runs them hours off.

workingHours.description: Opening hours per weekday; screens outside them follow the outside-hours policy.

screenCount.description: Screens at this location, when the endpoint includes it.

companyId.description: Owning tenant. Derived from the caller's token, never the body.

type.description: Which resources the tag may be applied to.

companyId.description: Owning tenant. Derived from the caller's token, never the body.

deviceIdentifier.description: Hardware id reported by the paired player; null until pairing.

hasKioskPin.description: Whether an exit PIN is set. The PIN itself is stored hashed and is never returned — this boolean replaces it.

storageUsedBytes.description: Bytes, as a STRING. The column is a 64-bit integer and would lose precision as a JSON number, so PrismaService serialises BigInt via toJSON.

affected.description: How many screens the operation touched.

companyId.description: Owning tenant. Derived from the caller's token, never the body.

screenCount.description: Members, when the endpoint includes them.

companyId.description: Owning tenant. Derived from the caller's token, never the body.

fileSize.description: Bytes, as a STRING — a 64-bit column serialised via BigInt.toJSON.

isExpired.description: Derived at read time from expiresAt — there is no such column.

purged.description: How many trashed items were permanently removed.

companyId.description: Owning tenant. Derived from the caller's token, never the body.

itemCount.description: From a Prisma _count; the list does not load the items.

isExpired.description: Derived at read time — no such column.

effectiveDurationSeconds.description: What actually plays, after per-item and per-type defaults.

valid.description: False when the referenced content cannot play.

issue.description: Why the item cannot play — expired, archived, trashed or deleted content.

companyId.description: Owning tenant. Derived from the caller's token, never the body.

itemCount.description: From a Prisma _count; the list does not load the items.

schedulable.description: At least one playable item AND status ACTIVE.

targetId.description: The referenced entity, or 'company' for a company-wide target.

companyId.description: Owning tenant. Derived from the caller's token, never the body.

priority.description: Higher wins when two schedules cover the same screen and time.

timezone.description: IANA zone the times resolve against; a bare city name runs the schedule hours off.

cacheSizeBytes.description: Serialised as a string — a 64-bit column, not a JSON number.

availableStorageBytes.description: Serialised as a string — a 64-bit column, not a JSON number.

screenshot.description: Defaults to true when the device has not reported.

reboot.description: Defaults to false when the device has not reported.

powerControl.description: Defaults to false when the device has not reported.

kiosk.description: Defaults to false when the device has not reported.

autoStart.description: Defaults to false when the device has not reported.

status.description: DERIVED on every read from the last heartbeat, not a stored column — a paired screen with no fresh heartbeat reads OFFLINE without any scheduler having written that.

warningReason.description: Set only when status is WARNING.

paired.description: True only for a device row in ACTIVE status.

fileSizeBytes.description: Serialised as a string — a 64-bit column, not a JSON number.

url.description: Short-lived signed URL. null when signing failed; the caller re-reads rather than caching it.

payload.description: Command-specific arguments; `{}` for the parameterless actions.

result.description: Whatever the device reported back; null until it completes.

expiresAt.description: A command not collected by this time is marked EXPIRED on the next poll.

syncBreakdown.description: Screen count per sync status. The keys are whatever the fleet is currently reporting, plus 'NONE' for screens with no device row — so it is an open map, not a fixed set.

missingHeartbeat.description: Paired screens whose derived status is OFFLINE.

type.description: Dotted event name. Free-form: a new event type needs no schema change.

data.description: Event-specific payload, e.g. the screen id to deep-link to. `{}` when unset.

readAt.description: null means unread — there is no separate boolean.

eventType.description: The dotted event name this preference applies to.

updated.description: How many notifications were still unread.

companyId.description: null for a platform/system alert, which only a Super Admin sees.

type.description: Dotted event name. Free-form, same as a notification type.

severity.description: Shares NotificationSeverity — there is no separate alert-severity enum.

triggeredAt.description: When the condition was first detected.

broadcastType.description: Which of message/url/contentId/playlistId carries the payload.

priority.description: Outranks every schedule while the broadcast is ACTIVE.

recipients.description: Recipient email addresses. Stored as a JSON array on the row.

filters.description: Report-type-specific filters, stored as free-form JSON. `{}` when unset.

enabled.description: A disabled report keeps its schedule but is never run.

nextRunAt.description: When the maintenance sweep will next pick this up.

recipientEmails.description: The addresses this attempt was sent to, as resolved at run time.

fileStorageKey.description: Object-storage key of the rendered file. Internal path — recipients receive a signed URL by email (valid 7 days); there is no endpoint that turns this key into one.

error.description: Why the delivery failed. Set when every recipient email failed to send.

sentAt.description: null when the status is FAILED — the file rendered but reached nobody.

recipients.description: Recipient email addresses. Stored as a JSON array on the row.

filters.description: Report-type-specific filters, stored as free-form JSON. `{}` when unset.

enabled.description: A disabled report keeps its schedule but is never run.

nextRunAt.description: When the maintenance sweep will next pick this up.

deliveries.description: The 20 most recent attempts, newest first. Not paginated and not configurable.
